title: Codex and OpenCode plugin setup
summary: Add Codex/OpenCode setup commands and plugin bundles with planner routing.
description: Implement current Codex and OpenCode harness setup/plugin support without coupling planner core to either harness. Current state: packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts has setup claude-code and a stale setup codex that writes .codex/mcp.json; plugins/codex/README.md is only a placeholder; plugins/claude-code/ and scripts/sync-plugins.cjs provide the existing shared skill/template pattern; docs/setup-codex.md and README.md describe older Codex behavior. Desired state: setup codex writes current Codex config.toml MCP configuration and installs/discovers the Agent Plan plugin/skill where supported; setup opencode creates project/user OpenCode config for @agent-plan/mcp and /planner command routing; plugin bundles under plugins/codex and plugins/opencode reuse the canonical planner guide. Preserve harness-agnostic core boundaries: do not move planner business logic out of @agent-plan/mcp/@agent-plan/core, and document any harness limitation such as Codex slash-command autosuggestion if not exposed by public APIs.

acceptedDecisions.title: Codex uses MCP plus skill instead of custom slash command
acceptedDecisions.decision: Codex support ships as MCP configuration plus an agent-plan skill/plugin bundle. Agent Plan must not claim Codex has a native custom /planner slash command or nested autosuggestion until Codex exposes a public API for it.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Current Codex CLI/plugin surfaces expose MCP servers, plugins, and skills, but no documented custom slash-command registration surface. Promising /planner in Codex would mislead users.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: agent-plan setup codex writes .codex/config.toml and .codex/skills/agent-plan/SKILL.md. plugins/codex ships plugin.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json, mcp.json/.mcp.json, and a generated skill.

acceptedDecisions.title: OpenCode gets /planner plus flat autosuggest aliases
acceptedDecisions.decision: OpenCode support uses mcp.servers.agent-plan plus a commands.planner entry for /planner arguments, and installs flat shortcut commands for discoverability instead of pretending nested segment autosuggestion exists.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: OpenCode v2 command configuration supports a slash command name with a template; nested segment-level autosuggestion for every /planner subcommand is not exposed in the verified config/CLI surface.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: agent-plan setup opencode writes opencode.json or ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json with commands.planner and shortcuts such as planner-load, planner-task-start, and planner-web-status.

tasks.title: Implement Codex and OpenCode setup/plugin routing
tasks.description:
Implement the Codex and OpenCode integration slice. Code references: packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts currently has CLI setup helpers, setupCodex writes stale .codex/mcp.json, and plannerCommandTemplate generates Claude slash routing; plugins/codex/README.md is a placeholder; plugins/claude-code/skills/planner/SKILL.md and plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in carry the canonical planner operating guide; scripts/sync-plugins.cjs only mirrors Claude; docs/setup-codex.md and README.md need current setup guidance. Work: add agent-plan setup opencode with --user/--project/--force/--local parity; update setup codex to current config/plugin expectations; add Codex and OpenCode plugin bundle files that reuse @agent-plan/mcp instead of duplicating planner logic; provide /planner command routing where the harness supports it and document tested autosuggestion limitations; add focused tests for generated config and plugin sync. Edge cases: preserve existing unrelated config, --force overwrites only Agent Plan entries, --local stores the resolved built CLI path, and no setup command auto-starts the planner or dashboard.

OpenCode setup writes mcp.servers.agent-plan plus commands.planner and flat autosuggest aliases such as planner-load and planner-task-start.
